rows.text: July 7, 2006
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the benchmark call rate (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (4.25%) for the intermeeting period.
(The following is an unofficial English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision
In the real economy, exports continue to exhibit steady growth, the recovery of private consumption has been maintained, and facilities investment is still recovering gradually.
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the benchmark call rate (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (4.25%) for the intermeeting period.
On the other hand, construction investment shows lackluster movements.
Meanwhile, the current account has shifted into surplus due to the widened goods account surplus, and the reduced repatriation of dividends.
(The following is an unofficial English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
In the real economy, exports continue to exhibit steady growth, the recovery of private consumption has been maintained, and facilities investment is still recovering gradually.
Both consumer price inflation and core inflation maintain overall stability.
Nevertheless, there exist persistently inflationary pressures due to the economic recovery and high oil prices.
On the other hand, construction investment shows lackluster movements.
Meanwhile, the current account has shifted into surplus due to the widened goods account surplus, and the reduced repatriation of dividends.
The upward pace of real estate prices has slowed down.
Both consumer price inflation and core inflation maintain overall stability.
In the financial markets, overall liquidity conditions are favorable and financial institutions' loans continue to increase steadily.

Taking the above economic and financial conditions into consideration, the Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the benchmark call rate (uncollateralized overnight rate) at its current level (4.25%) for the intermeeting period.
